sources.name: Agência Brasil
sources.permissions: Reproduction authorized for journalistic purposes with source credit; photographs only if authored by AB/EBC and credit known. Exclude third-party agency material without permission. Commercial uses require licensing.
sources.imagePolicy: Only known EBC/AB-owned photos; per-article credit required. RSS imagem-destaque does not itself establish authorship.

sources.name: Agência Câmara
sources.permissions: News reproduction free with Agência Câmara signature and appropriate author/photo credit. Per-story footer repeats authorization.
sources.imagePolicy: RSS content:encoded contains .midia-creditos author and img src. Restrict photos to Câmara-owned or other explicitly authorized agencies.

sources.name: Agência Senado
sources.permissions: Articles/photos freely reproducible without mischaracterization, with Agência Senado AND author credit. Audio: Rádio Senado; video: TV Senado and author.
sources.imagePolicy: No images supplied in standard RSS. Obtain and verify attribution from article or show typographic card.

sources.name: Agência Pública
sources.owner: Agência Pública — organização de jornalismo investigativo sem fins lucrativos
sources.permissions: CC BY-ND republication requires complete unedited report, attribution and republication seal; excludes columns/newsletters; photos only together with reports. MVP should index supplied headline, date, author, URL only; no full text, abridged report or photo. This metadata-only interpretation is conservative, not explicit additional publisher permission.
sources.imagePolicy: Do not use Pública images in aggregator cards.
